name: dojo-meter
description: See what each turn, agent and model costs, and how big your context is: a cost report from your transcripts, and a live band with the mod.

show_band.title: Show band (mod)
show_band.description: Mod only: draw the live cost band above the prompt. Needs function hooks enabled. /dojo-meter:band toggles it for the session.

budget_usd.title: Session budget in USD (mod)
budget_usd.description: Mod only: toast once at 70 and once at 90 percent of this session's list-price estimate. Per session, resets on resume. 0 turns it off.

context_warn_tokens.title: Context warning in tokens (mod)
context_warn_tokens.description: Mod only: toast when the last main-thread request holds more tokens than this, and suggest /compact. 0 turns it off.
